data.bio: Craig is a seasoned tradesman with over a decade of experience under his belt. He's honed his skills and expertise through years of dedicated work in the industry. Yet, when he's not on the job, Craig trades his tools for a backpack and hiking boots. He loves nothing more than spending his off days camping and exploring the great outdoors with his wife and kids, creating cherished memories amidst nature's beauty.
data.memo: Craig can complete all plumbing & HVAC related tasks & furnace repairs and installs
